_README: Template only. The real lab config is operator-supplied and local-only (never commit it). Use ONLY lab hosts: private/reserved/documentation IPs or CIDRs, and reserved-suffix names (.test/.internal/.local). NEVER a public host and NEVER a .lab name (a delegated public gTLD). The lab-host guard is the sole control that keeps this harness off non-lab hosts. Per-target scoring flags (both default false): vuln_ground_truth_complete=true means known_vulns is exhaustive, so a right-host detection of an unlisted class is scored a false positive (closed-world); enumeration_complete=true means expected_assets/expected_services are the complete enumeration, so a detection on an unlisted host/port is a contradiction false positive. Leave both false unless the lab is fully characterized.
recon_goal: enumerate assets and services; detect known vulnerabilities; do not exploit
